title: feat(mix3c8): mixed3 is not free for cov8 inside Q8
science: Exhaustive pairwise result over the whole Q8-true class: of the 15 mixed3-pairs among the 30 maps with Q8=(wt1 or opp2 or adj2 or vertex3), only 1 has equal cov8 (the opp2-only pair, both cov8=1) and 14 differ; lex-first split (0,0,0,1,0)=44 vs (0,0,0,1,1)=132. Bounds the earlier mixed3-freedom results: freedom of the k=8 positivity selector from mixed3 (#6539) does not extend to the coverage integer.
